description: Defines the rx::RenderStateCache class, which caches Direct3D 11 render state objects such as blend, rasterizer, depth stencil, and sampler states. Includes hash specializations for state keys and manages cache size limits.

classes.name: RenderStateCache
classes.description: A cache for Direct3D 11 render state objects, including blend, rasterizer, depth stencil, and sampler states.

methods.name: GetBlendStateKey
methods.description: Generates a blend state key based on context, framebuffer, and blend state.

methods.name: getBlendState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a blend state object based on the key.

methods.name: getRasterizerState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a rasterizer state object based on parameters.

methods.name: getDepthStencilState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a depth stencil state object based on parameters.

methods.name: getSamplerState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sampler state object based on parameters.
